title: Geologic map of the Georgetown North quadrangle, Georgetown County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2014, Geologic map of the Georgetown North quadrangle, Georgetown County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-207, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single map sheet read from OCR (page 1). OCR places map symbols loosely between descriptions; symbols were recorded only where on the same line as the unit name (dg, QPpm) or directly below its description (Qe, flagged inferred). Other symbols in the text (QHfm, QHfw, QPpam, QPps) could not be tied to a unit with certainty and were not recorded. The Water map unit was not recorded. Pleistocene units are interpreted as alloformations bounded by unconformities. The map graphics (contacts, drill-hole locations) are not readable from the OCR text.
SUBSURFACE: margin elevations bounding each alloformation (Silver Bluff above 6 ft seaward, below 10 ft landward; Princess Anne above 10 ft, below 18 ft; Pamlico above 17 ft, below 25 ft; page 1). SCGS drill holes are plotted on the map with log identification numbers (e.g. 22-138); the logs are on file at the SCGS and are not in this document (page 1). No cross sections or structure contours appear in the OCR text. Datum: horizontal 1927 North American Datum (base map, page 1); the vertical datum is not stated.
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single OCR map sheet; map face is noise). Units as before; map symbols read from the legend boxes on a page-image tile (the OCR placed them loosely). Pleistocene units are interpreted as alloformations bounded by unconformities. Alloformation margin elevations (Silver Bluff 6/10 ft, Princess Anne 10/18 ft, Pamlico 17/25 ft, seaward/landward) are recorded as contacts and as stated unit tops at those margins (boundary inferred; no vertical datum printed). Two thicknesses with '|' for the first digit read as 1 (inferred). Whole-page image checked: no cross section or structure contours; SCGS drill holes (22-xxx) are plotted on the map face by label only, without depths (logs on file at SCGS), so none is recorded. Water unit and legend-only symbols not recorded.
